01 · What is different here

The pressures we see in small business

Tools adopted one at a time

Individuals sign up for AI tools with company data. A one-page list of what is used, by whom and with what data is a real control.

Output that looks right

Fluent answers are easy to trust. A small set of examples you re-check regularly catches problems early and costs little.

Knowledge that lives in one head

Short architecture notes make a system understandable to the next person, and to the coding assistant your team uses.
